push.title: L 1-4 vs Real Zurich FC | You: 8.7 (4th best match performance of the season)
push.body:
tuxedo_slide, an 8.7, your 4th best match performance of the season. You're trending the right way.

THE GOOD
+ 8 tackles attempted (up from your usual 4). You chased like a golden retriever after a tennis ball, and I mean that as a compliment.
+ An 8.7 ranks as your 4th best match performance of the season. That's who you are on a good day.
+ Passes attempted 18, from 8 in your previous match. If the rest of the night was a storm, that was the lighthouse.

THE BAD
- BellyTb1 had the same passing accuracy trouble. Team up on it: give each other short options.
- Goal involvements 0, down from your usual 1. It happens. It can't keep happening.
- In our wins you average 1 key passes; here it was 0. That's not you at your best, and we both know it.
- Most missed tackles on the team: 5 (best was buddskees's 0). Let's sharpen this: Show them down the line, toward the touchline and away from goal, then strike.
- 4 goals conceded: -0.1. Like leaving the porch light on all day. Small, but it adds up.

THE UGLY
! Pass accuracy 44% (8 of 18). We don't sweep that under the rug. We look at it, then we fix it. Game plan: Count your touches. Two-touch is a habit that keeps your head up and the ball moving.

Warm-up idea: Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it.

tuxedo_slide, one more thing before you log off: If you're gonna make a mistake, make it at full speed and learn it at half.

That's championship stuff. - Coach Lasso

PhogsToffees, a 7.2 against Real Zurich FC. You were close to a good one. Let's find the missing piece.

- 0.6 under average. Even good weeks have a rainy day.

PhogsToffees, something I want you to sleep on: Every game is a teacher. Some just grade harder.

Patience with yourself, please. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 1-4 vs Real Zurich FC | You: 7.1 (3rd worst match performance of the season)
push.body:
A 7.1, buddskees. It's okay to be frustrated. It's not okay to stay frustrated.

THE GOOD
+ 3 key passes, the most you've made for us. That's a pass with a bow on it.
+ Better pass accuracy than any of their humans (80% vs their best 68%). More of that, please and thank you.
+ Team-high 1 goal involvements. That's a keeper. The habit, not the position.

THE BAD
- Only 15 passes (up from your usual 10). Here's what helps: Drift into the half-space between their midfield and defense. It's the hardest spot to mark. Small fix, big smile.
- No tackles attempted. Here's how: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.
- Their best midfielder posted 9.5 to your 7.1. That's the one I'd circle in red.
- defensive work rate got you and BellyTb1. Communicate and pass runners off and track them into the box.
- Shots on target 0, down from your usual 1. Little adjustment: Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.

Training-ground special: Check away, then check back. A two-yard feint buys you the space to receive.

Before you go, buddskees: If it was easy, everybody'd be in Division 1.

Let's turn the page. - Coach Lasso
